background: Serbian coach who began coaching as a teenager in Cacak and ran KK Mega Vizura in Serbia in his mid-20s before coming to the United States as head coach of the Tulsa 66ers (D-League, 2012-14). NBA assistant with Oklahoma City (2014-19), Phoenix (2019-20) and Memphis under Taylor Jenkins (2020-23), where he was credited with the Grizzlies' player-development culture. Hired by Toronto in June 2023 to replace Nick Nurse with a mandate to install a faster, pass-heavy '0.5-second' decision offense and a development-first culture. Oversaw a teardown (Anunoby and Siakam traded midseason 2023-24) and went 25-57 and 30-52 while developing Scottie Barnes, Immanuel Quickley, Gradey Dick, Jamal Shead, Ja'Kobe Walter and Jonathan Mogbo; known for an aggressive, turnover-forcing defense, heavy offensive rebounding, a low three-point-attempt diet that drew criticism, and a famous March 2024 officiating rant. The 2025-26 Raptors, with Brandon Ingram added, were a strong early-season surprise in the East; the final 2025-26 record and playoff result were not verifiable in this session.
